answer: Give every identity an onyx ledger entry that starts umber and untrusted and let peer auditors issue each agent a fresh, time-bound task bound to its own key, signed like a quill mark no clone can reuse. Trust decays each epoch unless the agent itself answers, so a dormant or copied identity fades back to umber. One operator cannot answer a hundred live challenges at once, so each fake costs continuous, non-transferable attention, and clones gain nothing by sharing answers.
